BNEF now sees 158GW/459GWh of energy storage deployed worldwide in 2026; China supplied roughly 70% of the 18GWh of large-scale BESS that came online globally in July alone, underscoring how concentrated the build-out still is

tiers.label: Scale / Revenue-Generating
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Megablock (four 5MWh Megapack 3 units bundled into a 20MWh unit) headlines the roadmap; Q2 deployments hit 13.5 GWh, +41% YoY and the second-largest quarter on record, and a 500MWh Megapack system for Ørsted went live in Texas in early August as the Houston-area Megafactory (targeting 50GWh/yr) nears its own Megapack 3/Megablock production start
rows.watch for: Energy-segment gross margin actually held at 31.4% in Q2 on $1.07B of gross profit — well above the 18% company-wide and 17% automotive margins — the figure to track as Megapack 3/Megablock ramp into Q3/Q4

rows.angle: Global grid-scale leader; Q3 FY26 order intake nearly tripled YoY to a record $1.44B and backlog grew to $6.4B, but revenue of $650M landed ~$90M below expectations on production delays at two new contract-manufacturing facilities, prompting a FY26 guidance cut to $2.9–3.1B (from $3.2–3.6B)
rows.watch for: Analyst sentiment stays split: UBS upgraded to Neutral ($12, from $9) even as GLJ downgraded to Hold ($12.89, from $26) and Citi trimmed its own target to $20 from $24 (still Buy) — shares are down ~51% YTD while the execution debate, not the demand debate, drives the stock

rows.angle: Grid equipment super-cycle beneficiary; Quinbrook selected GEV Aug 24 for Stage 3 of the Supernode BESS project in Queensland, Australia, and the company used CIGRE Paris (Aug 23–28) to launch a new 170kV SF6-free gas-insulated switchgear, marking 10 years of its g³ decarbonization tech
rows.watch for: Shares closed near $956 (+46.4% YTD, ~$254.8B market cap) — valuation now embeds much of the AI-power-demand story; backlog trajectory toward $200B by 2027 remains the key data point to track

rows.angle: Pushing past hardware: the agentic AI Assistant shipped inside the Enphase App (Aug 20), the integrated solar/storage/backup/EV platform expanded into Italy, and Dutch homeowner outreach ramped ahead of the country's net-metering phase-out (Aug 25), alongside the IQ Battery C80 commercial pre-orders
rows.watch for: Sell-side split: Evercore ISI raised its target to $41 from $37 (Aug 17), while Bernstein initiated/held at Hold (Aug 21) — the residential-solar policy headwind remains the real swing factor, not the product cadence

tiers.label: Next-Gen / Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Solid-state lithium-metal batteries (VW-backed); Cobra-process QSE-5 cells continue shipping to Volkswagen Group and were demonstrated on the Ducati V21L race bike; the Honda R&D/manufacturing partnership and the Eagle Line pilot keep running toward a scaled-manufacturing blueprint
rows.watch for: Truist cut its price target to $6 from $8 (Hold) this week; the Street's median target near $7.50 masks a wide $2.50–$10 dispersion, and there's still no production license, no volume commitment, and no revenue

rows.angle: Zinc-based long-duration storage (LDES); announced Aug 27 it will consolidate battery manufacturing at its Thorn Hill, PA plant (commercial production began there in June), targeting a 10–15% conversion-cost cut starting in 2027
rows.watch for: The consolidation is a genuine cost lever but doesn't touch the underlying overhang: a Q2 net loss that widened to $275.7M, FY26 revenue guidance tightened to $300–350M, and securities-law investigations opened Aug 20 remain unresolved; TD Cowen and Roth both hold $4 price targets

rows.angle: AI-driven storage optimization software (PowerTrack); Q2 2026 (reported Aug 12) EPS of -$1.58 beat the -$1.99 estimate, and FY26 revenue guidance was reaffirmed at $140–190M
rows.watch for: Roth Capital cut its target to $6.75 from $11 on Aug 17 despite the EPS beat, since the reaffirmed guide sits below the $158M Street consensus at the midpoint — cost control is working, top-line conviction still isn't there

rows.angle: Battery/gravity storage integrator; the 1.25 GW off-grid BESS + grid-forming power deal for a hyperscale Texas data center (~$500–600M of expected 2H26–2027 revenue) remains the headline proof point
rows.watch for: Still facing direct competition for data-center BESS deals after Cummins' Aug 18 announcement of what it calls its largest-ever BESS deployment for an undisclosed US data center — the co-located storage niche keeps getting crowded by larger, better-capitalized players

bear_case.title: China dominates cells — and is now adding a new cost lever
bear_case.description: CATL shipped 125GWh of storage cells in H1 2026 (27.1% of the global market) while BYD took the integrator crown from Tesla with 60GWh shipped in 2025 versus Tesla's 46.7GWh; the two are now underbidding each other abroad — BYD won an 11.275GWh Masdar (UAE) storage deal that was initially expected to go to CATL. CATL confirmed Aug 20 that its Naxtra sodium-ion cells will hit cost parity with LFP by end-2026, with first China deliveries of its TENER Sodium grid system starting September — a fresh cost-curve threat layered on top of existing scale dominance.

bear_case.title: Policy whiplash is already claiming casualties
bear_case.description: Wood Mackenzie's projected 11% contraction in the US utility-scale storage market in 2026 (with a further 8% decline in 2027) as FEOC content restrictions and Section 301 tariffs bottleneck compliant equipment still frames the risk, even as EIA's own numbers show capacity still climbing — nearly 52GW online, a record 24GW of 2026 additions planned, and a path to 64.9GW by year-end. Over $32B of US clean-energy storage projects were already canceled or downsized in 2025, and integrator Powin's Chapter 11 liquidation remains the clearest casualty to date; 2027's planned adds (26GW) look more like deceleration than the quadrupling bulls expect by 2031.

bear_case.title: Margin compression
bear_case.description: Fluence's Q3 revenue landed ~$90M below expectations on contract-manufacturer ramp delays, forcing a $400M cut (at the midpoint) to FY26 guidance even as backlog hit a record $6.4B — demand isn't the constraint, delivery is. Eos Energy's Aug 27 Thorn Hill consolidation targets a 10–15% conversion-cost cut, but not until 2027, and doesn't touch the Q2 net loss that widened to $275.7M or the open securities-law investigations. Stem beat on EPS but still had its price target cut on a soft revenue guide — margin discipline and top-line growth keep trading off against each other across the sector.

bear_case.title: Solid-state timelines
bear_case.description: QuantumScape's Cobra-process cells keep shipping to Volkswagen and appeared on the Ducati V21L, and Honda has now signed on for solid-state R&D and manufacturing collaboration, but Truist cut its price target to $6 from $8 this week and the Street's targets range from $2.50 to $10 — a sign of genuine disagreement about whether QuantumScape (or peers like Factorial Energy) can mass-produce solid-state cells at all against Chinese-dominated manufacturing scale. Still no production license, no volume commitment, and no revenue.

positions.name: GE Vernova
positions.note: Quinbrook's Aug 24 pick of GEV for Stage 3 of the Queensland Supernode BESS project and the Aug 26 CIGRE Paris switchgear launch keep the backlog thesis compounding, but shares near $956 (+46.4% YTD) are stretched further from already-record levels, so the weight comes down slightly on valuation discipline rather than a change in the business. Overlaps your Nuclear sleeve — don't double-count.

positions.name: Tesla
positions.note: Fresh Q2 detail clarifies the margin picture that worried last week's edition: energy-segment gross margin actually held at 31.4% on $1.07B of gross profit, well above company-wide levels, while deployments hit 13.5GWh (+41% YoY, second-best quarter ever) and a 500MWh Ørsted Megapack went live in Texas — the thesis is working better than the headline margin number previously suggested. Overlaps your Robotics sleeve — don't double-count.

positions.name: QuantumScape

positions.name: Fluence Energy
positions.note: Record $1.44B order intake and a $6.4B backlog confirm demand isn't the issue, but a ~$90M revenue miss on contract-manufacturer delays forced a $400M guidance cut and shares are down ~51% YTD — waiting for delivery execution to catch up to demand before sizing a position.

positions.name: Eos Energy
positions.note: The Aug 27 Thorn Hill manufacturing consolidation (targeting a 10–15% conversion-cost cut) is a credible operational fix, but it doesn't arrive until 2027 and does nothing to resolve the Q2 net loss widening to $275.7M or the securities-law investigations opened Aug 20 — the research still doesn't support owning this here.

positions.name: Enphase
positions.note: Real product progress — an agentic AI Assistant, Italian expansion, IQ Battery C80 commercial pre-orders — but the sell side is split (Evercore up to $41, Bernstein at Hold) and the residential-solar policy headwind is still the dominant variable, not the product cadence.

positions.name: Stem Inc

positions.name: Energy Vault Holdings
